answer: What keeps this honest is Chartered shipwright apprenticeship with boatbuilders guild certification, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 554 fakes pay 554 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. A terrace of doubt is healthy, a spiral of proof is required, and a comet of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
